notes: Perth, Australia (Arief Muslim). Clear skies. Moon age at sunset +10h07m, elongation 5.85°. Explicit non-sighting. Conjunction 2025-02-28 00:45 UT. Strict provenance: https://astronomycenter.net/icop/ram46.html?l=en
Blacksburg VA, USA (Dr. Javad Torabinejad). Hazy but clear horizon. First naked-eye at 6:37pm EST (~18h post-conjunction after binocular assist). Detailed log + conditions. High quality record.
Fort McMurray, Alberta, Canada (Mohammad Jassim Ahmad). Partly cloudy, clear conditions, naked eye + CCD confirmation. One of the northern positive reports on the 28th.
Munich, Germany (Eng. Martin Elsaesser). Clear gaps, CCD/telescope at ~5.4° elongation, ~9h post-conjunction. Photographed successfully. Excellent marginal aided record.
Thurlestone, UK (Juned Patel). Superb conditions. Seen with 25x100 binoculars at 18:27 local for 2s at +2.17° altitude. Explicit instrument + timing. Not naked eye.
Shobak, Jordan (Dr. Anas Sawallha + Jordan Astronomical Society group). Partly cloudy, telescope + CCD positive at 1° altitude. Binocular attempt failed. Group multi-observer confirmation.
Tindouf / south Algeria (Eng. Kacem Bankih + group of 17). Clear but hazy. Binocular + naked eye positive in southern locations. Group confirmation + photo.
Surakarta, Central Java, Indonesia (AR Sugeng Riyadi, Assalaam Observatory). Totally cloudy. Explicit non-sighting under poor conditions. Good counter-example record.
Cairo area, Egypt (Hussam Almoslem). Superb conditions. Naked eye positive on the easier second evening (~34h age). Classic easy naked-eye case.
Shahreza / Damzad, Iran (Hossein Janghorbani group + Mohaddeseh Alinezhad first naked eye at 18:03). Partly cloudy/hazy. Multiple observers, first naked eye confirmation.
Dhaka, Bangladesh (Mir Muhammad Ahsan Ali). Clear skies. Naked eye positive. Representative South Asian easy sighting.
Tangier, Morocco (Hatim El Harrak). Clear. Naked eye positive on 1 March. Good North African record.
